title: Lawlessness in Islamabad: Pak Air Force officer shot dead while rescuing woman from abduction
desc: A Pakistan Air Force Group Captain was shot dead in Islamabad after intervening to rescue a woman from an abduction attempt, according to Samaa TV. The suspect, a colleague of the woman, fled the scene after opening fire. The incident highlights the deteriorating law and order situation in Pakistan's capital.
